report.title: Sample media name checking report 3
report.description: Report allows experts to provide a corrected names for a (user entered) sample media item. Version 3 supports drop-down and freetext correction attributes (the freetext is for the user's 'Other' selection)
report.query:
SELECT #columns# FROM indicia.cache_samples_functional csf JOIN indicia.cache_samples_nonfunctional csnf on csnf.id = csf.id
JOIN sample_attribute_values sav_entered_species on sav_entered_species.sample_id = csf.id AND sav_entered_species.sample_attribute_id = #entered_species_smp_attr_id# AND sav_entered_species.deleted = false
JOIN cache_termlists_terms ctt_entered_species on ctt_entered_species.id = sav_entered_species.int_value AND ctt_entered_species.termlist_id = #target_flower_termlist_id#
LEFT JOIN sample_attribute_values sav_entered_species_other on sav_entered_species_other.sample_id = csf.id AND sav_entered_species_other.sample_attribute_id = #entered_species_other_option_smp_id# AND sav_entered_species_other.deleted = false
LEFT JOIN sample_attribute_values sav_corrected_termlist_species on sav_corrected_termlist_species.sample_id = csf.id AND sav_corrected_termlist_species.sample_attribute_id = #corrected_termlist_species_smp_attr_id# AND sav_corrected_termlist_species.deleted = false
LEFT JOIN cache_termlists_terms corrected_termlist_species_term on corrected_termlist_species_term.id = sav_corrected_termlist_species.int_value AND corrected_termlist_species_term.termlist_id = #target_flower_termlist_id#
LEFT JOIN sample_attribute_values sav_corrected_freetext_species on sav_corrected_freetext_species.sample_id = csf.id AND sav_corrected_freetext_species.sample_attribute_id = #corrected_freetext_species_smp_attr_id# AND sav_corrected_freetext_species.deleted = false
WHERE #sharing_filter# AND csf.survey_id in (#survey_ids#) AND csnf.media IS NOT NULL AND ((trim('#year_sort_order#') = '0' OR '#year_sort_order#'='<please select>' OR csf.date_end >= CAST((0-(#year_sort_order#)::int)::text || '-' || '#min_month_day#' as date)) AND (trim('#year_sort_order#') = '0' OR '#year_sort_order#'='<please select>' OR csf.date_start <= CAST((0-(#year_sort_order#)::int)::text || '-' || '#max_month_day#' as date)))

param.name: target_flower_termlist_id
param.description: ID of the target flower termlist

param.name: entered_species_smp_attr_id
param.description: Sample attribute ID that holds the entered species termlists_term the user entered

param.name: other_entered_species_tt_id
param.display: Termlists_term ID for the species Other option
param.description: Termlists_term ID for the Other species option

param.name: entered_species_other_option_smp_id
param.display: Entered Species Other option sample attribute ID
param.description: Sample attribute ID that holds the Other option text entered by the user

param.name: corrected_termlist_species_smp_attr_id
param.display: Corrected termlist species sample attribute ID
param.description: Sample attribute ID that holds the corrected termlist species entered by an expert

param.name: corrected_freetext_species_smp_attr_id
param.display: Corrected freetext species sample attribute ID
param.description: Sample attribute ID that holds the corrected freetext species entered by an expert

param.name: year_sort_order
param.description: Select a year, or leave blank for all years

param.name: survey_ids
param.description: Comma separated list of Survey IDs to limit report to.

param.name: intersect_location_ids
param.description: Sample locations must intersect these locations.

param.name: min_month_day
param.description: The earliest allowed date in the year to return data for. In the format mm-dd

param.name: max_month_day
param.description: The latest allowed date in the year to return data for. In the format mm-dd

report.columns: -- Leave empty cells on grid for expert entry
